| [CLAIM-600](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-600.md) v10 | Safe withdrawal needs a self-sustaining process | The assistant's, at the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to characterize "what differentiates transient support that induces dependency and is hazardous to remove from transient support that builds new capabilities and is safe to remove", with reintroduction and ecological recovery proposed as cases.   supply at all, and in Kerr solitons with a supply that does not depend
  on the structure, so they do not identify state-dependent upkeep.
- It sharpens [CLAIM-600](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-600.md). Persistence through many turnovers is not
  evidence of self-maintenance.
The routes are told apart by what happens when the supply is withdrawn and by whether an outflow is measured. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
